SOM.note: No link to the civil register is stated; birth certificates are still required beside the ID.

facts.fact: Hiiraan reports that about half a million Somalis have registered for the NIRA biometric card, about 2.5% of the 19.7 million population (divided by the population held), against a government goal of at least 20 million.

SOM.note: No number at birth is mentioned.
Only donor support is mentioned; no operating or maintenance arrangement is stated.
The president ordered institutions to link to the ID but no register is stated to be keyed on it.

facts.fact: Hiiraan reports that NIRA is issuing a biometric national ID card, with about half a million people registered, and that the president ordered all agencies and businesses to link to it.
